prompt: Write a method that takes a BlogContext (DbSet<Post> Posts with Title and Views) and returns the titles of posts with more than 100 views, ordered by Views descending. Return only a C# code block.

Write a method that takes a BlogContext (Blog has collections Posts and Contributors) and loads all blogs together with both collections so the caller can modify the entities and save them. Return only a C# code block.

Write a method that takes a BlogContext and a prefix and returns the posts whose Title starts with the prefix. A C# helper `TitleRules.HasPrefix(string title, string prefix)` already exists. Return only a C# code block.
Write a method that takes a BlogContext (DbSet<Post> Posts with Title and Views) and returns the titles of posts with more than 100 views, ordered by Views descending. Return only a C# code block.

Write a method that takes a BlogContext (DbSet<Post> Posts with Title and Views) and returns the Title and Views of posts with more than 100 views, ordered by Views descending. Return only a C# code block.

Write a method that takes a BlogContext (DbSet<Post> Posts with BlogId, Title and Views) and returns the total Views per BlogId for posts whose Title contains a search term. Return only a C# code block.
Write a read-only method that takes a BlogContext (DbSet<Post> Posts with Title and Views) and lists each post's Title and Views. Return only a C# code block.
Write a method that takes a BlogContext (DbSet<Post> Posts with Id and Title), loads the post with a given id, changes its Title, and saves the change. Return only a C# code block.
